title: Reject malformed and duplicate persisted Multi-Site egress entries before materialization

opportunity.rootCause: SitePersistenceCodec.FromRow validated persisted egress ports only. Invalid or duplicate hosts and schemes could be materialized into a GatewaySite before the later snapshot activation gate.
opportunity.risk: Malformed database policy can reach API/runtime objects and create inconsistent egress matching or ambiguous policy state before activation validation runs.

implementation.behavior: Persistence materialization rejects empty or invalid hosts, duplicate normalized hosts, empty/out-of-range/duplicate ports, empty/unsupported schemes, and duplicate schemes; valid hosts and schemes are canonicalized before constructing SiteEgressPolicy.

red.result: failed 1/1 because malformed and duplicate persisted egress entries produced no exception

verification.relatedRegression: passed 75/75 across configuration, editor, persistence, activation, security, health-trend, UI-contract, and handoff classes
verification.broaderCrossModule: 81/83; the two failures were live health-probe tests blocked by socket_AccessDenied on loopback listeners, outside this change

boundary: Live PostgreSQL malformed-row execution and persistence reload were not available in this environment
Live loopback health-probe tests were blocked by socket_AccessDenied
